name: icon-scatter
title: Icon Scatter
description: A field of line icons draws itself over the outgoing scene, covers the swap, then scatters outward to reveal the incoming scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .isc-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: Playful or app-style pieces where icons are part of the brand.
A short cover transition that hides the swap behind a graphic field.
avoidWhen: When the icon set would clash with the brand's own iconography.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Icon count
variables.description: How many icons populate the field.

variables.label: Cover color
variables.description: Fill that hides the swap at the field’s peak.

variables.label: Cover opacity
variables.description: Peak opacity of the cover fill.

variables.label: Stroke width
variables.description: Icon stroke width in 24px icon units.

variables.label: Fly distance
variables.description: How far icons fly when they scatter, in pixels.
